lyrics:
[Intro: ticking rhythm box, low synth pulse, startup chime]

[Verse 1: vocoder voice, robotic]
We are installing
We are restarting
Update nine of twelve
We are almost new

[Chorus: second vocoder harmony, bright synth tune]
Do not turn off
Do not turn off
We are the updates
Do not turn off

[Instrumental: bright melody, electronic handclaps]

[Verse 2: vocoder voice, robotic]
We fixed a problem
You did not notice
We made a new one
You will notice soon

[Chorus: second vocoder harmony, bright synth tune]
Do not turn off
Do not turn off
We are the updates
Do not turn off

[Break: rhythm box only, deep voice in German]
Bitte warten. Bitte warten.

[Final Chorus: all voices, tune an octave up]
Do not turn off
Do not turn off
We are the updates
Thank you for your patience

[Outro: progress tone rising, startup chime]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 116 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Ticking, tidy and mechanical, with a bright tune and dry humour.

VOICE: All voices are through a vocoder: a main robot voice in a monotone, a second one harmonising a fifth above in the choruses, and a deeper one speaking two words of German in the break. No natural voice.

INSTRUMENTS: A ticking vintage rhythm box, a low sequenced synth pulse, a bright, simple analogue lead tune, electronic handclaps and zaps, a vocoder, a string-synth pad, a computer startup chime and a rising progress tone.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, ticking and chime. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:00 Instrumental. 1:20 Verse 2. 1:44 Chorus 2. 2:04 Break, German. 2:20 Final chorus. 2:46 Outro, progress tone and chime at 3:14.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1978 electronic pop: dry, clean and precise, analogue synths with no reverb, every part in its own space.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'We made a new one. You will notice soon.' at 1:32.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original robots announce they are ready to serve. The machines people actually live with mostly announce that they are busy improving themselves and must not be disturbed.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Polite, busy, faintly ominous, finished.
